comment: The staged surface of @specstride/testkit is the subset a host needs (the split, phase 3): the EP-01 suite with its fixtures, the release-condition rule a host judges its own live-run entry row against, and the release-attestation check a host judges its own published versions by (phase 4).

exportsSubset keeps the eight rows of that surface; every other row (the suites of EP-02 to EP-19, the root index, the canary, the tables, the view suite, the EP-14 owner modules) stays repository-only.

modules is the closed set of built files the surface reaches by static import: the EP-01 trio, the frame, its two helpers (common, degrade), the runner frame (run, imported by the suite's casesAsTests), the built-in plain-shell sample, the amendments checks, and the two release rules (conditions, attestation; Node built-ins only).
fixtureFiles are the corpus files the staged surface reads at run time, copied at the same repository-relative spelling, so the frame's root resolves to the package root in an installed tree.
assetDirectories is empty on purpose: packages/testkit/data holds only the performance goals of the package's own tests, which a host does not run.

The owner modules of EP-14 stay out because they reach @specstride/kernel at run time (registerDoctorCheck, registeredDoctorChecks) and read the doctor tree, which core does not publish; a host supplies its rows as an input instead (the split, phase 2).
